sentiment: Smaller and louder at once — a model in your pocket, a coffee machine that never stops talking — yet we draw the house by hand.

stories.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
stories.summary: A whole speech model packed into 16.9 megabytes. The most impressive work of the day was the smallest — restraint and care beating raw size.

stories.title: Man discovers his parents' coffee machine used 1TB of data in 10 days
stories.summary: A coffee maker quietly uploaded a terabyte in ten days. The machines around us have grown far louder than we asked for, and most of us never hear it.

stories.title: I hired an illustrator to draw my house. Now it's my Home Assistant dashboard
stories.summary: He paid an artist to draw his house, then wired the drawing to his smart home. A handmade thing made useful again — warmth laid gently over the machinery.
